title: Accelerator response and lift-off slowing
summary: Reviews discuss strong accelerator response and immediate slowing when lifting off the accelerator, with sentiment often unclear from the fragment alone.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise quick pick-up and satisfying accelerator response when pressing down.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the car slowing too quickly when the driver lifts off the accelerator.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe strong acceleration, jumpy low-speed response, or immediate lift-off slowing without enough context to confirm praise or criticism.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment picture is incomplete.
Several examples are brief or lack context, making it hard to tell whether the described accelerator or lift-off behavior is liked or disliked.
The topic combines accelerator responsiveness with regeneration or deceleration on lift-off, which are related but not identical aspects.
